newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: BPI, Citytrust total assets 170 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: BPI, Citytrust total assets 170 bln pesos.

text.p: The merger between Bank of the Philippine Islands and CityTrust Banking Corp will produce combined total assets of 170 billion pesos, BPI president Xavier Loinaz said on Tuesday.
BPI will also have total capital of 20 billion pesos following the merger, Loinaz said in a statement.
The merger took effect on Monday with the de-listing of Citytrust shares.

BPI had earlier said the merger will increase its branch network to 409 from the present 357 and has projected it will also yield an annual 20 percent increase in its net income for the next five years.
